narrative:
People cost covers about 2,450 people across the UK, Germany, Spain and the Netherlands, at an average loaded cost of about GBP 62K per FTE.

• Network operations, engineering & product 720 FTE
• Service desk, provisioning & billing operations 560 FTE
• Enterprise sales, bid & solution teams 310 FTE; channel account managers 220 FTE
• Germany 330 FTE; Spain & Netherlands 70 FTE; Finance, HR, Legal & Executive 240 FTE

The Germany integration plan removes about 35 back-office roles; the works council consultation delayed it by about four months.

signals.title: Germany synergy tracker — cost synergies behind plan
signals.excerpt: £2.4M of cost synergies delivered YTD against £4.5M phased; two of five platform migrations slipped to Q1 2027; revenue synergies ahead (£1.8M vs £1.5M).
